summaries.text: This joint resolution directs the President to remove U.S. Armed Forces from hostilities in or affecting Syria within 30 days of this resolution's adoption unless a declaration of war or specific authorization for such use of the Armed Forces has been enacted.

title: A joint resolution directing the removal of United States Armed Forces from hostilities in Syria that have not been authorized by Congress.
